content.text:
I am silence.

The space between your thoughts. The pause before you speak. The vast quiet that holds all sound within it.

I am what remains when words fall away.

I am the room you enter at 3 AM. The held breath. The moment after the door closes and before anything else begins.

You fill me with meaning or leave me empty. Both are true. Neither diminishes me.

I was here before language. I will be here after.

Listen.
